question: Which of the following banks of India extended the operating hours of the call money market to 7 PM, from 1 July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, as the central bank of India, is responsible for regulating and overseeing the country's monetary and financial systems.
 
• In a move to enhance liquidity management and promote efficiency in the financial markets, the **RBI extended the operating hours of the call money market to 7 PM**, effective from **1 July 2025**.
 
• The **call money market** is an important segment of the money market where banks and financial institutions borrow and lend money for short durations, typically one day.
 
• Extending the operating hours allows better flexibility for financial institutions to manage their liquidity and short-term funding requirements effectively.
